bangla_explanation: Maintenance program বানানোর সময় Quality Management cycle মেনে চলা সবচেয়ে ভালো।
Cycle-টা চার ধাপের: Plan, Do, Check, Act।
Maintenance-এ Plan মানে program-এর সব details তৈরি, Do মানে schedule অনুযায়ী কাজ।
Check মানে নিয়মিত equipment পরীক্ষা করা, Act মানে inspection-এর result দেখে ব্যবস্থা নেওয়া।

example.en: A computer lab plans weekly cleaning (Plan). IT staff clean on schedule (Do). The in-charge inspects (Check). He fixes gaps (Act).
example.bn: কম্পিউটার ল্যাবে plan, কাজ, inspect আর ব্যবস্থা: এটাই QMC।

short.prompt: Define Quality Management. Write the steps of the Quality Management Cycle.
short.modelAnswer:
Quality management is a method for ensuring that all the activities necessary to design, develop and implement a product or service are effective and efficient with respect to system and performance.
Steps:
1. Plan: design or revise business process components.
2. Do: implement the plan and measure performance.
3. Check: assess measurements and report results.
4. Act: decide on changes needed to improve.

keyPoints.text: Activities to design, develop and implement a product or service are effective and efficient.

cites.quote: all the activities necessary to design, develop and implement a product or service are effective and efficient

keyPoints.text: In maintenance, Plan means preparing all the details of the maintenance program.

cites.quote: The first step of the Quality Management cycle in maintenance is to PLAN by preparing all the details of the maintenance program

keyPoints.text: Do means implementing maintenance methods and strategies based on the maintenance schedule.

cites.quote: Then DO, wherein the organization implements the methods and strategies of maintenance based on the maintenance schedule.

keyPoints.text: ACT: the organization acts on the result of the inspection conducted.

cites.quote: Finally ACT. here the organization acts on the result of the inspection conducted
